Oneliner

Demonstrate the onboard extraction of coastal and vegetation boundary data from Earth Observation (EO) images.
Description

Demonstrate the onboard extraction of coastal and vegetation boundary data from Earth Observation (EO) images to better arm researchers and policymakers working to limit the effects of climate change.
Notes

Finalist in the Launch UK Nanosat Design Competition.
